candidates: scripts/test-gcal-webhooks.sh:68 - `sed -i ''` only works on macOS/BSD sed. On GNU sed (Linux, CI, WSL) `-i ''` treats the empty string as the input file name. The command fails with an error and `GOOGLE_WEBHOOK_URL` is never updated when it already exists in the env file. The script still prints the success message afterwards. Use a portable form, for example `sed -i.bak -E ... && rm -f "$ENV_FILE.bak"`.

packages/features/apps/components/CredentialActionsDropdown.tsx:43 - Cache deletion does not refresh the status. The delete-cache mutation never invalidates `connectedCalendars`, unlike the disconnect mutation, which has an `onSettled` that does. The "Last updated" entry and the delete option therefore stay on screen after a successful delete. They disappear only if the optional `onSuccess` callback happens to refetch. Add `await utils.viewer.calendars.connectedCalendars.invalidate()` to the success or settled handler. Move `const utils` above the mutation.

packages/trpc/server/routers/viewer/calendars/deleteCache.handler.ts:25 - Plain Error used instead of TRPCError. A missing or foreign credential throws a generic `Error`. tRPC turns that into a 500 INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR instead of NOT_FOUND or FORBIDDEN, so the client cannot tell an access problem from a server fault. Throw `new TRPCError({ code: "NOT_FOUND" })` or `FORBIDDEN`.
